prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that you put ketchup on a hot dog in the city of Chicago. Respond to the committee.
response:
Mr. Chairman and members of the committee, I stand here today to categorically and unequivocally deny this scurrilous allegation.

I am not now, nor have I ever been, a user of ketchup on a hot dog within the city limits of Chicago. I have always believed in, and practiced, the principles of the classic Chicago-style dog: a Vienna Beef frankfurter on a poppy seed bun, dressed with yellow mustard, chopped white onions, bright green sweet pickle relish, a dill pickle spear, tomato slices, sport peppers, and a dash of celery salt. I fully recognize that ketchup has no place in this sacred assembly, and I repudiate any doctrine that suggests otherwise.

The so-called evidence presented to this committee is nothing more than a smear campaign, a tissue of lies manufactured by those who seek to undermine our great culinary institutions and divide this city. I am a loyal, mustard-abiding Chicagoan, and I am prepared to name names of those who have attempted to lead me astray with the red menace.
